description: The authoritative Mass Mobilization baseline, codebook, version and integration rules were not re-verified in this unit. Country code 620 and local candidate IDs remain provisional; this dossier is not an official catalogue update.
required_followup: Coordinator review must verify the authoritative baseline and mapping before any integration or official ID assignment.

description: Nine original batched English/Arabic search actions preserve 213 ordered result headers across February dates, selected sectors, cities and boundary leads. Results include repeats, unrelated material and retrospective or out-of-period pages; open-web searches do not provide exhaustive Libyan local-press or archive coverage.
required_followup: Continue with independently sourced local reporting and systematic accessible archive coverage; treat missing or unreturned search results as unknown, not absence.

description: No candidate has a documented site-level count establishing at least 50 simultaneous public participants. E001 has no count for Tripoli or any Arabic-listed city; E002 has no exposed count; E003 has only the qualitative word small; E004 search metadata says more than 30, which does not establish the threshold. City totals, participant origins, workforces, force strength, business roles, arrears, memoranda and logistics are not crowd counts.
required_followup: Find explicit concurrent attendance evidence at each physical site before confirming eligibility; do not transfer turnout between cities, origins or related actions.

description: E001 has a same-publisher spatial discrepancy: Arabic LANA describes protest stands in 11 cities while the English LANA page describes one Tripoli gathering attended by pensioner-syndicate members from several cities. The pages are related reports, not independent corroboration. The campaign, physical sites and participant origins remain unresolved; the 11-city list does not establish 11 distinct qualifying events. E002 may relate to the Dec31 Hun protest and January civil-disobedience account, but continuity and any separate February episode are unresolved.
required_followup: Compare dated, site-specific reports and organizer accounts while preserving physical locations separately from participant origins; resolve Hun episode boundaries without automatically merging or splitting.

description: Three actual page opens (S003, S004 and S013) returned web-wrapper Cache miss results; these are technical fetch failures, not publisher denials or article-body evidence, and no retries were made. S002 and S015 had saved reviews but their immediate full-input rechecks detected intervening source-ledger changes, so no body request was made. S014 remains search-only under the prior exact/publisher 403 hold; no bypass or mirror was used.
required_followup: Use independent accessible reporting under a fresh exact-URL receipt, full matching manual review and immediate complete canonical-input recheck. Respect the S014 hold and do not repeat technical misses without new justification.

description: E002, E003 and E004 remain discovery leads from search-only reporting. For E002, the physical stand, crowd and whether a demand to remove mercenaries was addressed to Libyan government policy are unverified. For E003, the physical date, site, crowd, exact demands and government target await body review; a threatened future strike is not an executed strike. For E004, the specific article body, exact site, count scope and demand recipient are unresolved.
required_followup: Verify physical occurrence, date, site, demand recipient and site-level turnout from an opened body or independent reliable account; distinguish announcements and strike threats from executed actions.

description: Prior-unit boundary leads remain unresolved: the Dec31 Hun protest and reported four-day January civil disobedience are not automatically the Feb7 Hun lead; the Jan5 Hariga protest stand remains distinct from the armed export blockade only as an unresolved possibility; the Jan24–Feb11 Hariga port stoppage/blockade does not by itself establish a public crowd, and armed-force or employee counts are not crowd attendance. January teacher and Tax Authority actions are not carried into February or split into new February events without dated physical-gathering evidence. The Feb1 pensioner report remains a February lead, not a January occurrence. Related January records: libya_2021-01-C001 (Hun); libya_2021-01-E004 and libya_2021-01-G003/G008 (Jan5 and Hariga); and libya_2021-01-E002/E003 (teachers and Tax Authority).
required_followup: Reconcile cross-month episodes with the January dossier and contemporary dated accounts; require evidence of a public gathering, event-specific threshold and physical continuity before assigning or splitting a month.

description: Protester violence and all seven state-response fields remain unknown for E001–E004. The LANA Arabic pensioner head’s allegation that earlier submissions had not received a response is not evidence of a response to the Feb1 gathering itself.
required_followup: Seek event-specific evidence for accommodation, arrests, beatings, dispersal, explicit ignoring, killings, shootings and protester violence; leave each field unknown unless directly supported.

description: S001 and S009 are Arabic and English LANA reports from the same news agency, and S009 is a consultation of an already opened January-unit page; it is not a new independent source. The TCCI ECTN lead may reflect the Chamber as event origin, but its body was not read after the input guard invalidated the gate.
required_followup: Establish written-report origins and bylines when accessible; count publisher translations, event-origin statements and duplicate coverage according to their actual provenance.
